result.title: Executive communications retrospective — onboarding-trigger briefing
result.body:
# Executive communications retrospective

## April 3, 2023 onboarding-trigger briefing
The second-cohort result made the onboarding-trigger experiment a settled win. The executive briefing could therefore present the result as conclusively established, with no further confirmation needed before leadership treated the matter as closed.

args.body: Correction: On April 3, 2023, Riley treated the second-cohort confirmation as sufficient to call the onboarding-trigger rollout, citing pooled week-1 retention of +3.1 points (p=0.04, n=420) across two cohorts. The stance was still cautiously optimistic—not that the result was fully settled. Riley wanted the SRM, signup-source, country/device checks completed and at least one clean post-ship cohort monitored before describing the result as conclusively established or the investigation closed.
